_notes: Sheet 176 of the tournament savegame (8x4), read card by card from the image on 2026-11-07. CardID = 17600 + idx; 339 = character card (sheet 3, 10x7, index 39). The deck object of the save holds 31 cards: the 30 of the deck plus the character card, which is why the catalog says card_count 31 and card_ids [339, 17629]. Bullseye's deck is sheet 176 like Medusa's, the four turtles', Doctor Strange's and Bigfoot's: only deck.identity (data/tts/bullseye.json) tells the decks apart (docs/card-identity.md).

Hero card (read from the image): BULLSEYE, RANGED, START HEALTH 14, MOVE 2; special ability 'Bullseye can attack from up to 5 spaces away (ignoring zones).' No sidekicks (unmatched-memory has an empty sidekick entry, ignored). Every card carries the BULLSEYE band (none ANY): the restriction changes nothing while he has no sidekicks.

Reach: `reach_spaces` 5 is a HeroDef parameter, not a card effect: attack range is measured in spaces along the map's adjacency, whatever the zones, in addition to the ranged zone rule (Board.can_reach_target `reach`), for the engine's attack validation, the bot's positioning and the human's attacks. Another hero that attacks 'up to N spaces away' only needs its own number here.

Copies (xN printed on each card), type, value and boost match unmatched-memory for all 12 titles. Discrepancies: For My Next Trick says 'Move Bullseye up to 1 space' on the card where unmatched-memory has 'Move one of your fighters up to 1 space' (the same thing without sidekicks); Study The Target is one scheme whose text sits on two lines (unmatched-memory has no space after 'Draw 2 cards.').
